placement: Capability Pack — src/capabilities/store/ with its own contract unit. The engine declares database versions, stores and indexes; the pack creates what is declared, drops only what the engine names, and reports mismatches, conflicts, blocked upgrades, quota and unavailability as typed outcomes. A transaction is one atomic batch of operations answered Committed or Aborted with the failing operation; putIf is a mechanical compare-and-put for stale writes. Migration meaning stays in the engine. Core and Storage (localStorage) unchanged; absent unless registered. The smoke runner gains reload and quota-override actions.
